entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT
entities.description: NAS message used to reject a registration request from the UE.

entities.name: EAP-failure message conveyance
entities.description: Condition where the REGISTRATION REJECT message is used to convey an EAP-failure message.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REJECT message contains the EAP message IE when conveying EAP-failure.
Presence of EAP message IE in REGISTRATION REJECT is guarded by the condition of conveying EAP-failure message.
